summary: episode is removed as an external authority and CD-0086 is superseded in full. The knowledge ladder is observation, lesson, decision, and every rung exists today. lesson graduation replaces the episode promotion seam. External-system identity lives in managed_resources and learned usage is a lesson tagged resource:<id>; a record stores a vendor documentation locator, never vendor content. The seven episode rows are exported and migrate to lesson records in their own Product homes.
title: lesson owns the knowledge ladder
